svg.aria-label: A listing-form submission opens a GitHub issue. The Listing from issue workflow checks it, commits the listing to a branch named after the file, and opens a pull request; problems come back as an issue comment, and editing the issue runs the checks again.
svg.title: How a listing becomes a pull request
svg.desc: A listing-form submission opens a GitHub issue. The Listing from issue workflow checks it, commits the listing to a branch named after the file, and opens a pull request; problems come back as an issue comment, and editing the issue runs the checks again.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
